page_title: One daily note foreverything you’re running.

sources.entry: NotePlan 3 - Your tasks, notes, and calendar, plain-text markdown files. [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/en/app/noteplan-3/id1505432629?platform=mac)

summary.name: NotePlan 3
summary.one_liner: NotePlan is a planning app that combines daily notes, project notes, tasks, and Apple Calendar and Reminders in one place, stored as plain Markdown files.
use_cases: keep project notes, decisions, and next steps together
turn tasks into time blocks on a calendar timeline
run weekly reviews and set monthly or yearly goals
summary.what_it_does: NotePlan creates a daily note for each day, with Apple Calendar events shown beside it and Apple Reminders lists integrated so checking off a reminder there also checks it off in Reminders. Project notes can be linked to daily tasks, and dragging a task onto the timeline turns it into a time block next to meetings. It also creates weekly, monthly, and yearly notes for goals and reviews, and offers Kanban-style boards built from project notes. Notes are stored as plain Markdown files on the user's device and sync across devices through the user's own iCloud account.
notable: Daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly notes integrated with Apple Calendar and Reminders
Plain Markdown files stored on device, synced via the user's own iCloud account
Drag tasks onto a timeline to create time blocks beside meetings
Full URL scheme and Shortcuts support
caveats: Described as 'one subscription' for all apps, implying a paid subscription model
Web version is offered for PC use; native apps are Mac, iPhone, and iPad
Shared Spaces route data through NotePlan's servers
